top_signals.title: Central Asia Seeks New Trade Route to Pakistani Ports
top_signals.summary: Uzbekistan appears to be hedging its bets when it comes to Afghanistan’s ability to serve as a trade corridor. Over the past year, Tashkent has ramped up its engagement with Afghanistan, setting an ambitious target of almost tripling annual bilateral trade volume over the next few years.
